description: Add and manage comments on Windows folders.

releases.release_notes: # 🎉 Release v1.0.0 (Initial Release)  We are excited to announce the first official release of the **Folder Comments Shell Extension**!   This tool integrates seamlessly into Windows Explorer, allowing you to easily view, add, and edit custom folder comments directly from the native Windows **Folder Properties** dialog.   ### ✨ Key Features * **Native Explorer Integration:** Adds a dedicated Comments tab to the properties dialog of any directory. * **Windows InfoTip Support:** Comments are saved safely using native Windows APIs (). Your text will appear as a tooltip when you hover over the folder in Explorer. * **Massive Multilingual Support:** UI translated and ready for over 40+ global languages, including automatic Right-to-Left (RTL) layout switching. *(See full list below).* * **Built-in Auto-Updater:** Automatically checks GitHub for new versions in the background. Features a non-intrusive UI to Update Now, Remind Me Later, or Ignore a specific version. * **Clickable About Section:
